`enum Primitive`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.vertex` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Primitive.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/vertex/Primitive.java)

How the vertices of a draw join, in segments or in triangles.

## Description

`draw(primitive, buffer)` of the render bridge passes it to the backend, which maps it to the topology of its API; it is part of the [`PipelineKey`](/reference/pipeline/pipelinekey/) too.
The [`Tessellator`](/reference/drawing/tessellator/) turns every drawing mode into one of the two.

- [A draw call](/build/pipeline/#a-draw-call)
